continuation.question: does this environment support automatic continuation of the work?
continuation.answer: PARTIALLY — and the honest split matters.
supported: Zcode has persistent scheduled automation that outlives a session and survives app restarts: CronCreate (recurring workspace schedule) and OffPeakCreate (idle-time queue). Both re-enter this project with a complete instruction, not a nudge.
A recurring hourly schedule is registered: automation-66406963-b307-4962-ba44-03f48f178c43, cron '0 * * * *', title 每小时继续 CozyFocus 2.0 最终质量验收.

The schedule's prompt carries a guard: if MASTER_STATE.updated_at is under 25 minutes old it reports 'another window appears active' and exits without editing, so a scheduled run cannot fight an open session for the same worktree.
not_supported: Nothing available here extends one conversation's context window. When this window's budget runs out the window ends; it is not resumed mid-sentence.
Auto-compaction keeps a long session going, but it is not a continuation guarantee and must not be reported as one.
No mechanism can make a single run finish an unbounded program. Work is therefore cut into work units that each end at a committed, verified, resumable point.
continuation.explicitly_not_done: No claim that automatic continuation is solved. Repeating a prompt to look busy is not continuation and was not used. The real mechanism is: every work unit ends committed and recorded, and the hourly schedule (or the owner) can pick the program up from CHECKPOINT.md at any time.
continuation.timestamp_discipline: Every timestamp in these files is the host clock, not an estimate. An earlier window wrote times hours ahead of it, which would make the scheduled run's 25-minute guard skip every time. Re-read the clock rather than copying the previous value forward.

S3.01 the running screen now draws the design's ring (commit 05c0c4c, 4 tests, reverse-proved)
S3.02 the ring is sized from screen height so the controls stay on the smallest target (commit bec8026, 4 tests, reverse-proved)

S2.01 GLOBAL PALETTE: the primary green was a colour the designs do not contain. Measured across all 16 boards with tools/qa/palette_report.py — design primary #44714B covers 125,256 px on every board, the old #5E8D6D only 1,468 (anti-aliasing fringe). Changed one token; also fixes white-on-green contrast 3.81 -> 5.66 (was below WCAG AA). 6 tests, reverse-proved, device-verified at pixel level

S2.02 SPLIT CLOCK: RecordsController, ReportsController and progress_overview_page read DateTime.now() while the rest of the app reads FocusClock. This is why six tests were already red at HEAD and why one more passed vacuously. 3 guard tests on an ancient date, reverse-proved

S2.03 flaky test: RESOLVED, and it was a product defect. ReportsController's constructor fired an unawaited loadAllReports() while all three report pages already called it from initState — every visit loaded twice and the constructor's round could land after a teardown closed the database. Also de-flaked the room-placement test's fixed-frame wait, which was a real but different fragility

S5.03a ACCESSIBILITY, 21 sites: screen readers said the same words twice. Found one on the device (the capture sheet chip read '标签 生活\n生活'), scanned for the shape, then found two more classes only the platform's own tree could see — the bottom nav (icon semanticLabel duplicating the item label) and the timer (label interpolating the same value as the child Text). Fixed with excludeSemantics: true, or by removing the redundant semanticLabel. Guarded by a class-level scan in Dart plus a widget test, both reverse-proved, and device-verified on home, growth, room and the focus page
S1.07 design 07 statistics audited (structural: every element the design draws exists)
S1.09 design 09 timeline audited (structural; one open question about the design's fifth kind, registered as S1.09a)

S3.05a-e design 05 CLOSED: the four tags each draw their own icon (TaskCategory.iconName was dead data), selection is the brand green rather than the category colour, the count sits inside the field, and the field is four lines tall. 6 tests, all reverse-proved, device-verified
S3.03 home: the current-task card the design puts under the greeting is missing — DONE, CurrentTaskCard, device-verified, 9 tests

S3.04 home: the hourly focus chart — DONE, HourlyFocus + HourlyFocusChart, device-verified, 13 tests. The bucket size was measured (8 two-hour bars, 06:00-22:00, labels at their real clock positions) with tools/qa/chart_bars.py rather than guessed

S3.03a home: the duration selector — DONE. The title now reads 选择专注时长 (no emoji), every card carries a leaf (#7ABB55), and the chosen card is filled solid #517C52 with white text instead of primaryLight inside a border. Device-verified

S5.06 the home page now has its own test file (7 tests). It did have two tests in presentation_widgets_test.dart, which an earlier note of mine wrongly denied — corrected in the ledger rather than edited away

S3.03b home: 放松一下 is now its own card below 今天的专注, with the companion in its sleep pose, a subtitle and a chevron, instead of a second full-width button inside the focus card. Device-verified, 3 tests. DESIGN 01 IS NOW COMPLETE
S7.01 five deliverables written with real content (01, 04, 07, 08, 09)

S2.03 DURATION CONVENTION: the app turned seconds into a figure four ways — formatDurationText rounds, the weekly and monthly report pages floored their own split, the wrapped page rounded to whole hours. One week of 9,359 seconds read 2 小时 36 分钟, 2h 35m and 3 小时 on three screens. Unified on durationMinutes + durationParts; the per-screen formats are untouched. 6 tests, 3 reverse-proved. Deliberately NOT unified: RewardService.settle still floors, because paying for an unspent minute is a different mistake from rounding a display, and the code now says so where the two rules meet

S2.01/S2.05 RE-PROVED BY MUTATION, not inherited: removing _endAtForCountdown records 5640 s instead of 1500 and pays 960 coins instead of 50 — the original 94-minute defect reproduced exactly; making the settlement gate always true lets the second settle return true and doubles coins and XP. Idempotence rests on the reward_ledger primary key {sessionId} plus INSERT OR IGNORE and SELECT changes(), not on a comment

S2.06 CROSS-MIDNIGHT: found by asking whether the two day-total queries agreed (they do — both filter on startAt) and then noticing the hourly chart I added last round broke that same convention by capping its window at 24:00, so a 23:30-00:30 session contributed half an hour to bars beside a card printing the full hour. Window now measures from the day's start and follows a session past midnight; hour 24 renders as 0. 2 tests, reverse-proved

S2.06 PAUSE re-proved by mutation: dropping the pause subtraction in elapsedSecondsAt reads a 5-minute session as 1800 s instead of 1500 s, and takes the overrun-with-pause case red with it. The clock-safety file already covers NTP corrections, timezone changes and a user setting the clock back

S2.07 FIVE SOURCES AGREE: test/domain/five_sources_agree_test.dart asks the question against a real database — a 1,500 s session with a task, a 900 s one without, and a 45 s one, which is where rounding rules part company. The sharpest assertion is that the task total is strictly less than the day, so a query that forgot its task filter cannot pass by accident; dropping the filter gives 2445 against 1500

S5.03b THE DETECTOR ITSELF WAS WRONG: it flagged any repeated word, and reported the timeline's 专注任务 and the statistics card's 1 小时 42 分钟 — both repeated data, not doubled labels. A doubled label is adjacent (a merged wrapper sits immediately before the text it repeats); list rows that share a word are not. The rule now compares neighbours only, with a self-test over the four real cases and the three false ones: 8/8

S5.03c the task list announced every filter twice — 今天
今天, 进行中
进行中, 已完成
已完成. It survived the earlier sweep because the label is written _labels[filter] and the chip's text _labels[filter]!, and the scan compared the expressions literally; stripping a trailing ! found this one site and nothing else. Device-verified

S5.03d SEVEN BUTTONS NAMED BY A TOOLTIP, which is not a name. Measured in Flutter (label empty, the string in tooltip) and on the device (content-desc="", no tooltip attribute in the tree at all). The scanner's own docstring had the rule backwards, so it reported zero problems across all seven. Six took a semanticLabel on the icon; the seventh needed its Semantics wrapper dropped, because that shape produces two nodes — a probe shows the named wrapper and the IconButton's own unnamed one

S5.03e swept and verified on the device this window: the room page (its 库存 and 制作工坊 buttons were among the seven that had no name), the growth page, home, the settings page and the notifications page. The detector's third false-positive class was found and fixed — a row title sharing a word with its own subtitle — and is now a self-test case

CONTRACT CHECK on the settings rows, because 功能建设中 / 暂未启用 / 暂不可用 read like Coming Soon. They are not: only 通知 and 数据与同步 are clickable, both lead to real pages, and the notifications page states 不可配置 on every row with no toggle rendered at all. An explicit unavailable state, which the brief asks for, rather than a control that does nothing

S5.03f second half of the sweep, all device-verified and clean: create task (19 named controls), the weekly / monthly / yearly report pages, the settings and notifications pages, the dress page, the collection page and the inventory page. No new defects — the seven unnamed buttons fixed earlier this session were the last real ones. The dress page holds the explicit unavailable state the contract requires (装扮系统未连接数据，暂无可用装扮，无法穿戴) with no mock catalog

S5.03g ONE DELIBERATE NON-FIX, recorded rather than acted on: the collection cards read 多肉盆栽插画 / 多肉盆栽 / 未开放, which trips the detector. The card is drawn as a picture above a title and the same shape appears where the names differ, so it is the design, not a doubled label. The tool now prints candidates rather than verdicts and carries the reasoning

S3.06 design 04's control row: FocusControlRow replaces a full-width 记一下 above two full-width buttons. The board carries the hierarchy in size and weight — 暂停 largest and the only filled circle — where every control used to be the same shape. Three controls, not four: 白噪音 has no audio behind it and a round button that plays nothing is the fake control the brief forbids. 6 tests, reverse-proved, device-verified

S3.05 design 03's plan rows: one panel with hairlines and a rail, replacing a card each with a ten-pixel gap. The gap was the point — a rail cannot run through one, so the rows had to become one surface first. The rail fades from the dot's own colour to neutral, measured at #FAE8D4 under a #FDA23B dot and #ECE9E4 further down. Device-verified with three rows

S3.05a FOUND BUT NOT ACTED ON, deliberately: the design's category dots are 工作 #FDA23B, 学习 #FA6442, 生活 #FED355 against the app's catWork #E08373, catStudy #8BA4C8 (blue where the design draws red) and catLife #F0B367. A global change across every chip and dot, and the design disagrees with itself — the 工作 row's chip is green while its dot is orange. Marked NOT_VERIFIED rather than guessed
S3.08 the task list's completed row verified on the device: a solid green check, a pale green row, the title at normal weight rather than struck through, and the chevron. Matches design 02

S3.05a CLOSED AS NOT A DEFECT: the design-03 dot colours looked wrong against the app's category palette, so I measured design 02's chips — 学习 is a pale blue chip with blue text, matching catStudy #8BA4C8. The dots in 03 are not category colours at all (the same category is green as a chip and orange as a dot in one board, and design 09's legend uses dot colour for the row kind). The app is self-consistent

S6.A Golden Flow A walked on the device and it FOUND A DEFECT: a task completed on the task list was still offered as 下一个任务 on the today plan, because Task.status and TaskSchedule.status record two facts and the plan read one. Fixed read-side (PlannedTask.taskStatus, isOutstanding) with the placement deliberately not rewritten, since whether finishing a task closes its placement is a product decision. 3 tests, 2 reverse-proved, device-verified

S6.A-a defect 18, found by re-reading the records hub after fixing 17: the plan's remaining count lives on the controller's state, so the earlier fix missed it, and the hub's own task count read 进行中 while counting finished tasks too. Both now ask whether the task is done. The count had no test at all — which is exactly why fixing the row above it did not move it. 4 tests, 2 reverse-proved, device-verified

recent_test_evidence.result: 2005/2005 passed, analyze clean, format clean, APK builds
recent_test_evidence.note: The flake is resolved and it was a product defect, not the harness: ReportsController's constructor called loadAllReports() without awaiting it while all three report pages already called the same method from initState, so every visit loaded twice and the constructor's round could land after a test's teardown closed the database. It failed with no exception text at all, just '+2 -1'. Removing the constructor's call took the suspect file from 8/10 clean to 12/12. An earlier fix to the room-placement test's fixed-frame wait addressed a real but different fragility.
recent_test_evidence.before_this_window: 6 tests were red at HEAD (e8647f33) and had been for a day, because the records screen read the wall clock while the tests seeded against an injected one. The 1931/1931 recorded in the previous version of this file was stale.
